adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when a `destination.credentialId` is present but the credential cannot be resolved from `this.calendarCredentials`, it fetches from DB (`prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}})`). If the DB row is missing or `credentialFromDB.app?.slug` is falsy, `credential` remains `undefined`, and the subsequent `if (credential) { ... createEvent ... }` block is skipped with no `else` handling, no log, and no failure `EventResult` pushed. This matches the finding that a destination can be silently dropped (no created event, no visible error/result) when credential resolution fails due to the `app?.slug` gate.
